name: Floating Label Field
description: A field whose label rises into a notch cut in its hairline border, with error and success text that cross-fade in and a tick that draws. Monochrome, dark first.
usage:
import { FloatingLabelField } from "@/components/design-for-ai/input-floating-label";

<FloatingLabelField
  label="Work email"
  helper="We’ll send receipts and invoices here."
  errorText="Add a domain, like ana@studio.co"
  onValueChange={(value) => setEmail(value)}
/>

<FloatingLabelField
  label="Company"
  size="lg"
  prefix={false}
  suffix="Optional"
  counter
  maxLength={60}
/>

props.name: label
props.description: Resting label. It rises into the notch on the top hairline when the field is focused or filled.

props.name: helper
props.description: Helper text under the field, shown in the resting, focused and filled states.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Replaces the helper once the typed value has rested as an invalid email, or the field is left with one in it.

props.name: successText
props.description: Replaces the helper once the value is a valid email. The tick draws in the trailing slot at the same time.

props.name: state
props.description: Forces a state for review. Leave it unset and the field follows what is typed; disabled locks the input and dims it.

props.name: counter
props.description: Shows the limit as a faint "Max 40" at rest and switches to the live count once the value passes 80% of it.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Longest value the field accepts. The input stops at this length, so the counter can never read over the limit.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Shows the mail glyph in the leading slot. The text starts after it, and the notch moves with it.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Content for the trailing slot, such as a unit or a short action. The success tick takes this slot while the value is valid.

props.name: size
props.description: 56px or 64px tall. Text steps from 16px to 18px so it stays above the iOS zoom threshold.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black field with white ink, or the white inverse on paper.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Value on first render. A filled field rests with its label already on the line.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every keystroke with the current value, so the host can validate or save.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root, for width or margin in the host layout.

controls.label: Helper
controls.default: We’ll send receipts and invoices here.
